authorization: NEW_STUDY_AUTHORIZATION.json preserves the direct human instruction to repair and complete. Operator binds the final concrete F0 SHA before any reserved forward; no claim of verbatim EXECUTE_FROZEN or human inspection of the later SHA.

endpoint.native_stops: At 128 committed IDs, limit is required and inclusive EOG also requires a following EOS marker; below 128 only an inclusive EOG/EOS endpoint is allowed. No earlier EOG, missing, duplicate or reversed markers.

engineering.shared_engineering_observations: original UB1/reference and original batched each satisfy A/B original baseline roles with same explicit run IDs; B original/timer base denominator 216; formal never shared
engineering.replay_gate: 36/36 H2 vs fresh R_ONLY; model loading, allowed input, rollback independently checked
engineering.timer_gate: each of 3 original/timer conditions 36/36, not candidate/reference equality
engineering.candidate_observations: target-only UB2/H2/native batched, no gate or candidate selection

synthetic_endpoints.SYNTH_CAP: Write a detailed 2000-word story about a lighthouse keeper discovering a lost island. Begin the story immediately and include descriptions and dialogue.

engineering.state_fixtures: 5 R acceptance/correction/bonus/rollback fixtures on exposed HumanEval/3; 3 P width fixtures 0/1/2, separate from natural predictions

A.pre_live_order: selection rank then repetition 1,2,3 then fixed four conditions
A.gate_before_F2: four pre-live conditions repeat-stable and valid; H2/R_ONLY 57/57; UB2/reference difference legal
A.classification: full match with at least one actual reference-divergent prompt -> MATCH_DISCRIMINATING; otherwise MATCH_NONDISCRIMINATING; partial comparisons fully retained
A.independence: P loads draft only; R/R_ONLY target only; fresh R_ONLY consumes sealed per-round requests in order; original live imports no tape; shared original numeric DLLs disclosed

B.estimator: median(target ms for each prompt)/median(candidate ms for each prompt), then geometric mean over all distinct prompts
B.secondary: only both qualified: GM(batched median/serialized median), same indices; >1 serialized faster

timing.start: after synchronized target and draft initial prefill, before per-request sampler constructor/seed/reset/prompt acceptance
timing.end: after last committed ID, target/draft sync, response/log and slot release; excludes loading, initial prefill and teardown

clock_probe.scope: clock calls only; no subtraction or logging-overhead bound

B.output_already_exposed: B uses cohort preselected before A, cost study not fresh prospective prediction sample
B.position_balance: Each of the three conditions occurs 19 times in each order position. Six permutation frequencies are nine or ten; extra permutations are the three cyclic rotations, chosen before model observations.

runtime.physical_ubatch: native requested UB copied to draft by common_base_params_to_speculative
runtime.target_sampler: suppress vocabulary IDs; native identity transforms; greedy temp0 then dist123
runtime.draft_sampler: top-k10 and dist(default seed); reset per round; select sorted maximum; p_min0

failure_policy.scientific_mismatch: continue complete fixed schedule; no favourable subset
failure_policy.operational_failure: stop affected study at real prefix; no formal repairs/replacements/retries
failure_policy.A_pre_live_failure: irreversible A_TERMINAL before any B, prevents same-cohort A continuation
failure_policy.B_gate_failure: speedup/CI null for that candidate only
failure_policy.incomplete: INCOMPLETE_OPERATIONAL_FAILURE; actual counts not planned denominator

protected: old scientific files, manuscripts and tag unchanged; no merge/release/new scientific tag
